edges: Registry cleaners are not supported by Microsoft.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: A registry cleaner is used to remove redundant or unwanted items from the Windows registry.
Microsoft has a track record of creating innovative and user-friendly features, including a built-in registry cleaner in Windows.
